story_title: Lina and Adams and the Little Seed
title: Lina and Adams and the Little Seed 🥕 | Learn Garden Words in English for Kids | Moon Tales Kids
description:
Plant a little seed with Lina, Adams and Milo, and watch it grow! 🌱🥕🦋
In this English story for kids, children learn 8 new words: seed, soil, dig, grow, leaf, wait, carrot and butterfly. Listen, repeat, and learn English with Lina, Adams and Milo the cat.

📚 New words in this story:
🌰 seed — البذرة — la graine
🟫 soil — التربة — la terre
🕳️ dig — يحفر — creuser
🌱 grow — ينمو — pousser
🌿 leaf — الورقة — la feuille
⏳ wait — ينتظر — attendre
🥕 carrot — الجزر — la carotte
🦋 butterfly — الفراشة — le papillon

👨‍👩‍👧 For parents: play the story, pause after each new word, and ask your child to say it out loud. Perfect for ages 3 to 8 and for children learning English as a second language.

lines.text: One spring morning, Lina opens a tiny paper bag.
Adams, look! Grandma gave us seeds!
They are so small! What will they become?
Grandma says they will become carrots!
A seed is a tiny thing. When we plant it, a new plant comes out.
Say it with me: seed!
Lina and Adams go out into the garden.
Where do we put the seeds?
In the soil! It is soft and brown.
Milo puts his paw in the soil. Meow! It is cool.
Soil is the brown ground where plants live.
Say it with me: soil!
I will make little holes for the seeds.
Adams uses a small spade. Dig, dig, dig!
Not too deep, Adams. Just a little hole.
When we make a hole in the ground, we dig.
Say it with me: dig!
Lina puts one seed in each hole, and they cover them gently.
Now the seeds need water to drink.
I will water them with the watering can. Sprinkle, sprinkle!
They give the seeds a little water, every day.
Milo sits next to the garden. He is the garden guard. Meow!
Grow, little seeds, grow!
The next morning, Adams runs to the garden.
Oh! Nothing is here! Where are the carrots?
Seeds take time, Adams. We must wait.
When we stay calm until something happens, we wait.
Say it with me: wait!
Okay. I will wait. I will be patient.
Many days pass. The sun shines, and the seeds drink water.
Adams! Come quick! Something is coming out!
Tiny green plants! The seeds are growing!
When something gets bigger and bigger, we say it grows.
Say it with me: grow!
The little plants have green leaves now.
Look at this leaf. It is long and thin, like a feather.
Every day, there are more leaves!
A leaf is a flat green part of a plant.
Say it with me: leaf!
Lina touches a leaf very gently. Hello, little plant!
One day, a visitor flies into the garden.
Look! It has big orange wings!
It is a butterfly! It wants to see our garden.
Milo watches it, but he does not chase it. Good cat, Milo!
A butterfly is an insect with beautiful wings.
Say it with me: butterfly!
At last, it is time. Lina and Adams pull the plants. One, two, three, pull!
Carrots! Long, orange carrots!
We waited, and they grew. We did it together!
A carrot is an orange vegetable that grows under the ground.
Say it with me: carrot!
Crunch, crunch! The carrots are sweet and yummy.
At night, Lina and Adams are tired and happy.
We planted seeds in the soil. We dug, and we waited.
The seeds grew leaves, a butterfly came, and we got carrots!
Tomorrow, let's give some carrots to Grandma.
Good idea! Good night, Milo.
Good night, little garden. Good night, everyone!
